title: Average rate of change of a position function
change: New context (position function), cubic with negative left endpoint; distractors recomputed.

title: Average rate of change from a table
change: Function given as a table of data in a population context; different skill entry (read values, then secant slope).

title: Average rate of change of a rational function
change: Rational function in a speed/time context; non-integer answer with negative sign.

title: End behavior of an even-degree polynomial
change: Even degree, positive coefficient; choices reworded in words rather than limit notation.

title: End behavior from a product of factors
change: End behavior must be found from factored form with a negative leading term hidden in a factor.

title: End behavior of an odd-degree polynomial
change: Odd degree, positive leading coefficient, with a distracting even-degree second term.

title: Identify a hole in a rational function
change: Different polynomial (cancelation with x−4), question framed as describing the discontinuity.

title: Hole and asymptote together
change: Both a hole and a vertical asymptote in one function; requires y-value of the hole.

title: Hole in a quotient with a cubic
change: Difference of cubes requires polynomial division/factoring; hole y-value is not integer-trivial.

title: Crossing versus touching from multiplicities
change: Factored polynomial with three zeros and multiplicity 3; asks which zeros are crossings.

title: Choose a polynomial from graph behavior
change: Construct an equation from described graph behavior rather than interpret a given factored form.

title: Least possible degree from behavior
change: Reasoning about least degree from touch/cross behavior at three zeros.

title: Caution with a quadratic model
change: Physical context (ball), quadratic model, non-integer domain endpoints.

title: Caution with an exponential revenue model
change: Different function family (exponential) and a calendar-year context.

title: Evaluating a claim about model reliability
change: Conceptual evaluation of a claim rather than choosing a prediction.

title: Composition of linear and quadratic
change: Order of composition is f∘g (seed was g∘f); different functions and distractor types.

title: Composition involving a square root
change: Radical function composition with domain-neutral expressions.

title: Evaluate a composition with an exponential
change: Numerical evaluation of a composition with an exponential inner function.

title: Equal-degree rational end behavior
change: Equal degree case (seed was slant); different coefficients.

title: Slant-type end behavior with coefficients
change: Numerator given in factored form; the leading coefficient is not 1.

title: Denominator-dominant rational end behavior
change: Denominator degree greater than numerator degree (horizontal asymptote y = 0).

title: Model for percent decay
change: Decay instead of growth; different start value and rate.

title: Model from a doubling time
change: Growth specified by a doubling time instead of a percent rate.

title: Exponential model from table values
change: Model chosen from a table with common ratio rather than from a verbal rate.

title: Solve a logarithmic equation, base 3
change: Base 3, argument x+2, larger answer.

title: Logarithmic equation with a coefficient inside
change: Coefficient on x inside the log; base 5.

title: Logarithmic equation requiring a product and a rejection
change: Two logs combined by the product property and an extraneous root, a new situation relative to the single-log seed.

title: Solve an exponential equation in base 3
change: Base 3 with exponent 4x+2; different constants.

title: Solve with a shift in the exponent
change: Shift in the exponent with coefficient 1 on x; base 7.

title: Exponential equation with a coefficient and natural log
change: Natural log base and a coefficient in front of the exponential, requiring a first division.

title: Random residuals, logarithmic fit
change: New model type (logarithmic), good-fit case rather than curvature case.

title: Sign pattern for a linear fit
change: Linear model with explicit sign-run description instead of a U-shaped plot.

title: Comparing two residual plots
change: Two-model comparison; asks which model is supported rather than interpreting a single plot.

title: Isotope half-life fraction
change: Different isotope, half-life, and elapsed time (5 half-lives).

title: Drug concentration percent
change: Answer in percent, drug context, 4 half-lives.

title: Mass remaining of a sample
change: Starting amount given in mg, so answer is a mass, not a fraction.

title: Domain of a base-3 logarithm
change: Reflected quadratic argument (9 − x²) in base 3; answer is a bounded interval.

title: Domain of ln of a quadratic
change: Quadratic with linear term; factoring needed.

title: Domain of ln of a rational expression
change: Rational argument inside ln; sign analysis of a quotient.

title: Gate rotation in radians
change: New angle (210°) in a rotation context.

title: Turntable angle in radians
change: 135° with a turntable context; different error set.

title: Negative angle to radians
change: Negative angle, clockwise context.

title: Tide model amplitude and midline
change: Decimal values in a tide context; period is a distractor not used.

title: Amplitude and midline from extremes
change: Negative minimum; no period given.

title: Amplitude and midline from two points
change: Extremes given as coordinate points, requiring the y-values to be extracted.

title: Cosine equation on [0, 2π)
change: Cosine instead of sine; reference angle π/4.

title: Negative sine equation
change: Equation needs isolating sin x first; negative value.

title: Tangent equation on [0, 2π)
change: Tangent equation; period π means solutions are π apart.

title: Principal value of arcsine
change: Inverse sine with a negative value, whose answer is a negative angle.

title: Principal value of arctangent
change: Inverse tangent with different principal range.

title: Principal value of arccosine, √2/2
change: Reference angle π/4; stem phrased as an output-of-inverse condition.

title: Polar to Cartesian, (−4, π/3)
change: Different r and θ (−4, π/3).

title: Polar to Cartesian, (6, 5π/6)
change: Positive radius with a Quadrant II angle; sign of cosine is the key.

title: Polar to Cartesian, (−6, 7π/6)
change: Negative radius with a Quadrant III angle, double sign interplay.

title: Polar circle r = 6cos θ
change: Cosine form (center on the x-axis) instead of sine form.

title: Polar circle r = −10sin θ
change: Negative coefficient with sine, so the circle is below the origin.

title: Polar circle r = −2cos θ
change: Negative cosine; circle left of the origin with radius 1.

title: Zeros of a biquadratic
change: Different quartic (13, 36) and different error set.

title: Real zeros when x² = −4 appears
change: Quadratic in x² has one negative root, so only some zeros are real.

title: Cubic zeros by grouping
change: Cubic factored by grouping instead of a quartic in x².

title: End behavior of an even-degree polynomial
change: New even-degree polynomial with positive leading coefficient, terms written out of order, so the leading term must be identified.

title: End behavior of an odd-degree polynomial with a large even term
change: Odd-degree positive polynomial where a lower-degree term has a larger coefficient; verbal answer choices.

title: End behavior from a factored polynomial
change: Factored form with a repeated factor; degree and sign must be read from the factors.

title: Vertical asymptotes of a rational function
change: Different rational function, numbers and wording; distractors from numerator zero, reversed signs and a missing zero.

title: Vertical asymptote versus hole
change: A canceled common factor means one denominator zero is a hole, testing the 'noncanceled' condition.

title: Vertical asymptotes with numerator factors
change: Quadratic numerator and denominator, no cancellation.

title: Hole from a removable factor
change: Quadratic numerator with a non-obvious factorization; distractors include a wrong y-coordinate.

title: Hole coordinates from a factorable numerator
change: Leading coefficient other than 1 in the numerator; different function and distractor set.

title: Hole and asymptote in the same function
change: Function with both a hole and an asymptote, and a nonzero hole value that is a fraction.

title: Reading shifts and a vertical shrink
change: No reflection; includes a shrink factor of 1/2 and a leftward shift.

title: Reflection across the y-axis with an outside multiplier
change: Reflection inside the function with a different multiplier and distractors about inside versus outside.

title: Horizontal compression requiring factoring
change: Inside linear expression needs factoring to read the shift; combined with a reflection.

title: Second differences identify a quadratic
change: Concrete table in place of an abstract description; reasoned choices.

title: Third differences identify a cubic
change: Third differences instead of second; negative and zero outputs rule out exponential.

title: Quadratic with negative leading coefficient from a table
change: Context table with a downward-opening quadratic; asks for the sign of the leading coefficient.

title: Remainder Theorem with a positive root
change: New cubic and divisor; distractors use sign, constant term and exponent errors.

title: Remainder Theorem with x + 2
change: Divisor x+2 requires evaluating at −2; different polynomial.

title: Remainder Theorem with a missing term
change: Quartic with no cubic term, divisor x+1, even-power sign error.

title: Rational inequality with a nonstrict sign
change: Reversed inequality direction relative to the seed, with different numbers, wording and distractors.

title: Rational inequality with a reversed numerator
change: Numerator written as 9−x so the sign pattern flips; endpoint decisions required.

title: Rational inequality with three critical values
change: Three critical values with a factored numerator; endpoints and sign chart needed.

title: Predicted change in water level from a cubic model
change: Reservoir context, new cubic, and a decreasing result.

title: Predicted change in visitors from a cubic model
change: Positive change with new coefficients; distractors include evaluating at b−a.

title: Predicted temperature change from a quartic model
change: Quartic model in a temperature context.

title: Average rate of change of a cubic
change: Different cubic and interval; distractors from sign, multiplication and omitted division.

title: Average rate of change of a quartic
change: Quartic with a negative output at the left endpoint; divide-by-endpoint distractor.

title: Average rate of change of a drone's height
change: Context version with a drone's height and an output-averaging distractor.

title: Decay factor below 1
change: Decay instead of growth; different initial value and rate.

title: Small growth rate as a percent
change: Growth rate with a decimal that has two leading digits to convert.

title: Medication decay in context
change: Medication context with a decay factor; distractor for percent of the initial value.

title: Product of logs equation, base 2
change: New base 2, different equation and constants; extraneous-root trap kept but the distractor errors differ.

title: Quotient of logs equation
change: Quotient (derivable from product property) instead of product; no extraneous root, so the traps are different.

title: Log equation with extraneous root
change: New base, shifted arguments, key is x=0 with a quadratic that has an extraneous partner.

title: Inverse of shifted base-3 exponential
change: New base 3, shifts (+1, −4); distractor values re-derived with f(2)=23.

title: Inverse of shifted natural exponential
change: Natural-log base e and vertical shift +2, horizontal shift −3; checks use f(3)=3.

title: Inverse with exponent coefficient
change: Exponent 3x (a coefficient on x) with a vertical shift, a harder inversion than seed's pure shifts.

title: Composition of quadratic and linear
change: Different functions (quadratic outer, linear inner), distractors include a product and a binomial-squaring error.

title: Composition with square root
change: Radical outer function and quadratic inner function.

title: Evaluating a composition at a point
change: Numeric evaluation of a composition with a rational outer function.

title: Model selection from near-linear data
change: Near-linear data in place of seed's exponential data; distractors target ratio/difference misreadings.

title: Exponential decay versus linear fit
change: Decay data with distractors on reciprocal ratio and r² reasoning (a documented low-scoring reasoning pattern).

title: Quadratic from constant second differences
change: Exact quadratic data; distractors differ from seed's (average rate, ratios above 1).

title: Semi-log slope with base 2
change: Base 2 instead of 10, whole-number slope so no calculator is needed.

title: Semi-log line to exponential model
change: Asks for the whole model using both intercept and slope, rather than only b.

title: Semi-log with negative slope
change: Negative slope (decay) and base from log₁₀3.

title: Solve a log regression for x
change: New coefficients and target; distractors are derived from specific algebraic slips.

title: Solve exponential model for time
change: Exponential model solved with ln; different structure from the seed's log regression.

title: Log model with negative coefficient
change: Negative log coefficient adds a sign trap.

title: Exact sin(4π/3)
change: Sine at a quadrant III angle in place of cosine in quadrant II.

title: Exact cos(11π/6)
change: Quadrant IV angle where the sign is positive.

title: Exact cos(−2π/3)
change: Negative angle (even/odd symmetry) instead of a plain quadrant II angle.

title: Cosine with a minimum at x=0
change: Minimum (reflected cosine) with a period of 6, requiring b=π/3.

title: Sine increasing through the midline
change: Midline crossing (sine) rather than an extremum, with a long period.

title: Cosine with horizontal shift
change: Horizontal-shift matching for a maximum at a given x.

title: Evaluate sine model in radians
change: New context and constants; one distractor targets the horizontal shift.

title: Evaluate cosine model in radians
change: Cosine model with period 9.

title: Sine model written with period 24
change: Argument written as 2π(t−6)/24 and an exact sine value.

title: Simplify with tan and sec identity
change: Tangent/secant identity (derived form) instead of sine/cosine.

title: Simplify cos x over 1−sin²x
change: Reciprocal-function answer instead of a numerator identity.

title: Simplify sin²x over 1+cos x
change: Quotient requires factoring the numerator after the identity.

title: Identify a sine cardioid
change: New cardioid with sine and a minus sign, described by symmetry line, cusp, and farthest point; distractors are cos/sin swap, sign error, and loop misconception.

title: Describe a three-petal rose
change: Changes from cardioid to odd-n rose; asks petal count, length, and orientation.

title: Limaçon with an inner loop
change: New limaçon with |a| < |b|; options contrast cardioid, sine version, and no-loop limaçon.

title: End behavior of an even-degree polynomial
change: Even-degree, positive leading coefficient, x to negative infinity; distractors are sign, zero, and constant-term errors.

title: End behavior from factored form
change: Factored form with a repeated factor; the student must add multiplicities and use the sign of the leading coefficient.

title: Dominant term is not the largest coefficient
change: Uses a larger coefficient on a lower-degree term to test degree vs. coefficient; x to positive infinity.

title: Hole with its y-coordinate
change: Rational function given in expanded form; hole must be located with its y-coordinate.

title: Two holes and one asymptote
change: Factored form with two cancelling factors and one remaining; no calculation, just classification.

title: Partial cancellation of a squared factor
change: Tests multiplicity: a squared factor only partly cancels, so the 'hole' is actually an asymptote.

title: Hidden quadratic with a rejected root
change: New coefficients so one root is negative; targets the documented failure of not rejecting e^x = negative.

title: Quadratic form in 3^x
change: Base-3 version of the hidden-quadratic equation, with both roots valid; adds the base-3 vs ln conversion error.

title: Equation with e^(−x) term
change: Negative exponent term must first be cleared; distractors are u-values, reciprocal sign error, and one-sided multiplication.

title: Parameter b from cycles per time
change: Different context and numbers (9 cycles per 6 seconds); distractors separate total-time, frequency, and period errors.

title: Parameter b from a frequency in Hz
change: Hz-to-b conversion, a documented weak point; different context and numbers from the seed.

title: Parameter b from a maximum and the next minimum
change: Requires recognizing half-period between max and min; adds a second step beyond the seed.

title: Sine at a third-quadrant angle
change: Sine instead of cosine, third quadrant instead of second.

title: Sine of a negative angle
change: Negative angle with a π/4 reference value; different value set from the seed.

title: Unit circle point for an angle
change: Asks for the unit circle point rather than a single function value.

title: Polar to rectangular with negative r (5π/6)
change: Different angle (5π/6, second quadrant) and r; distractors are sign dropped, sign on one coordinate, and swapped.

title: Polar to rectangular in quadrant IV
change: Positive r in quadrant IV; different distractor set (reference-value reversal).

title: Polar to rectangular with negative irrational r
change: Negative radius that is irrational and angle 3π/4; the distractors isolate which coordinate loses the sign.

title: Degree from fourth differences
change: Fourth-difference data (outputs 0,1,16,81,256,625) with new framing.

title: Degree from second differences
change: Smaller case with second differences constant; distractors based on first differences, constant value, and number of points.

title: Degree from a list of first differences
change: Gives first differences instead of outputs, so one extra level must be accounted for.

title: Where secant is undefined
change: Secant instead of cosecant; new angle values.

title: Where cotangent is undefined
change: Cotangent; undefined where sine is zero.

title: Where sec(2x) is undefined
change: Horizontal compression inside secant; requires dividing the argument.
